tools.name: zenity.api.catalog
tools.description: RFC 9727 API catalog (application/linkset+json) for agent discovery.

tools.name: zenity.markdown.fetch
tools.description: GETs the Markdown representation for a path (blog home lists posts; `/blog?category=` filters like HTML; `/blog/{slug}` is a post — live/retired category path slugs redirect to `?category=` or `/blog` like HTML; resources deeper paths return category or article markdown).

pathname.description: Path without .md, e.g. /blog, /blog?category=security, /blog/post-slug, /resources/cat/slug (optional; defaults to current path + search)

tools.name: zenity.markdown.url
tools.description: Returns the `.md` URL for a pathname and the Accept header used for negotiation.

pathname.description: Path without .md, e.g. /blog, /blog?category=security, /blog/post-slug, /resources/cat/slug (optional; defaults to current path + search)

tools.name: zenity.site.sections
tools.description: Returns HTML and Markdown index URLs for main areas, plus per-section hub snapshots from Sanity (SEO, hero, featured content, category filters, first page of posts / use-case index metadata). Use zenity.markdown.fetch for full Markdown lists.
